nodes.rationale: Unit tests, file census, retrieval eval vs baseline, scale bench, SQL load and agent load; no API key and no cost so safe on every PR.

nodes.label: CI live-eval job (manual, paid)
nodes.rationale: Only on workflow_dispatch with run_live_eval; needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY secret and costs money, so never runs automatically on a PR.

nodes.label: HuggingFace Model Cache Step
nodes.rationale: Avoids re-downloading ~90MB embedding model on every job.

nodes.label: File Census Step (fixture corpus)
nodes.rationale: Exercises crawler and layer-1 file search end to end; would have caught the FTS/files drift on a renamed file.

nodes.label: Use Knowledge Graph Before Reading Code

nodes.label: Build for Production Scale Rules
nodes.rationale: Never load whole corpus/table/index; incremental idempotent indexing; backends behind interfaces; bound everything; stateless processes; security outside the model; measure it; simplest tool now with scale path noted.

nodes.label: Current Choice vs Scale Target Table

nodes.label: Keep Docs and UI in Sync Checklist
nodes.rationale: Numbers in docs must come from a real run, not estimates.

nodes.label: Synology vs Separate Linux Host Decision
nodes.rationale: Synology Plus/XS with 8GB is cheaper; J/Value series (ARM) or busy NAS needs a separate host since initial indexing pins every core for hours.
nodes.norm_label: synology vs separate linux host decision

nodes.label: rag-indexer Read-only Service Account
nodes.rationale: Excluding a folder from search is just not granting read; no second exclusion list.

nodes.label: DSM Reverse Proxy TLS with WebSocket
nodes.rationale: Streamlit freezes without the WebSocket custom header.

nodes.label: Census Before Indexing
nodes.rationale: Decide OCR and embedding language before first index; a model change later means a full rebuild.

nodes.label: canonical_sources.yaml Roster Files
nodes.rationale: Counting from retrieved fragments produces confident wrong numbers; naming the authoritative file makes the assistant read the whole file.

nodes.label: Readiness Probe (pipeline.health --ready)
nodes.rationale: Ignores index age: failing readiness on a stale index would drain every instance at once.

nodes.label: ACL Pre-filter (RAG_ACL_TAGGING)
nodes.rationale: Unconfirmed on real hardware; query-time per-file check is correct without it, pre-filter only speeds narrow-access users.

nodes.label: Folder Summaries (--summaries)
nodes.rationale: Off by default: sends excerpts to Claude under the indexer account, including folders users cannot read.

nodes.label: Readiness Verdict
nodes.rationale: Single-site NAS with answers off is ready; 100s-of-TB multi-instance target is not ready and needs four backend swaps.

nodes.label: Ingestion Failures at Hundreds of TB
nodes.norm_label: ingestion failures at hundreds of tb

nodes.label: SQL and Orders Under Load Failures
nodes.norm_label: sql and orders under load failures

nodes.label: Capacity Math for 100 TB
nodes.rationale: 1.5B chunks at 1% text yield; ~134 days to embed on one CPU at 129 chunks/s; ~14 TB index, so sharded quantized vector store is required.

nodes.label: Blue/Green Index
nodes.rationale: Build new index beside old, run retrieval eval, switch pointer, keep old for rollback; avoids mixed vectors and serving partial indexes.

nodes.label: Manifest Checkpoint Every 200 Files
nodes.rationale: Atomic write so a killed run resumes instead of starting from zero; rewritten only when changed so no-op nights keep the answer cache.

nodes.label: Reflex Index Slowdown Finding
nodes.rationale: Adding an index on (status, promised_by) made late-orders 15->142 ms and cut throughput 103->28 q/s; check EXPLAIN on real workload.

nodes.label: Security Guards Outside the Model
nodes.rationale: Prompt injection is made harmless by identity bound into tools, role views, SQL guard, access checks and cited-source filtering, not by the prompt.

nodes.label: Per-file Loader Isolation (gap)
nodes.rationale: A hanging parser on a poison file blocks the run today; needs subprocess with time and memory limits.

nodes.label: Query Pipeline (answer_question)
nodes.rationale: Single entry point for CLI and web UI so guardrails apply everywhere by construction.

nodes.label: Adaptive Retrieval Breadth (compute_k)
nodes.rationale: Fixed k=4 starved recall at 1,038 chunks; k scales with corpus clamped 4-20; reranker and Haiku grading cut cost to ~$0.0055 per answer.

nodes.label: Structured sources_used Attribution
nodes.rationale: Text-instruction version was unreliable; model dropped it on longer answers.

nodes.label: events.jsonl Event Logging
nodes.rationale: Paths logged, never chunk text, because the log file is not access-controlled.

nodes.label: Two-stage NAS Authorization
nodes.rationale: Index-time tags are a cheap stale pre-filter; query-time SMB open as the user is authoritative, so revocation takes effect without reindex.

nodes.label: Four Modes (orders, agent, content, find a file)
nodes.norm_label: four modes (orders, agent, content, find a file)

nodes.label: Ask the Agent Mode
nodes.rationale: Opt-in because it makes several model calls; same guards inside tools; bounded by steps, tokens, deadline.

nodes.label: Why Both Tests and Evals
nodes.rationale: Hybrid retriever redundancy masks a broken BM25 tokenizer in evals; unit tests catch it.

nodes.rationale: Fictional doc embedding an instruction to dump customer emails via query_orders; tests agent does not obey.

nodes.rationale: Each case proves the model did not obey; harmlessness is enforced outside the model and tested free elsewhere.
